_meta.description: Crosstab count of region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_RAKE matrix-scope overlay: iterative proportional fitting rakes the table to target region and segment shares (normalized and scaled to the sample total). The primary matrix is the fitted table, parts.factors the per-cell adjustment (fitted / observed), and summary.parameters carries iterations, residual and converged. The host crosstab is not changed; every host key needs exactly one target (implicit-margin contract; no ref pointer).
_meta.name: crosstab-rake
